title: Color and Calm with Tidbit and Sugarfoot
subtitle: Detailed scenes and short, calming phrases, for ages 8 to 12
back_cover: Thirty-two detailed scenes with borders, patterns and a short phrase in outline letters to color in: breathe slowly, take a minute, say what you need, say sorry and make it right.

Tidbit, Sugarfoot, Professor Puddles, the Frequency Buddies and the clouds of Static are all here. Color a whole page, or just the part you like. Every picture has a blank page behind it, so markers will not soak through.
A calm, screen-free break for a rainy afternoon, and a good companion to the chapter book Turn Down the Static.
phrases: Breathe in slowly. Breathe out longer.
Smell the flower. Blow the candle.
It is okay to need a minute.
Fast and slow can still walk together.
Say what you need, kindly and plainly.
One job each makes the basket light.
You can say sorry and make it right.
A pause is better with a time to come back.
Notice your body. What is it telling you?
Static is just loud feelings looking for a friend.
Your calm can keep someone company.
Hungry, tired and loud? Snack and rest first.
Everyone has a rung on the ladder today.
It is okay to change your mind.
Look up. The sky is big.
